description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating bounding boxes and computing metrics like IoU and Generalized IoU, specifically for object detection tasks. It includes conversions between box coordinate formats, IoU calculations, GIoU calculations, and deriving bounding boxes from masks.

methods.name: box_cxcywh_to_xyxy(x)
methods.description: Converts bounding box coordinates from center-form (cx, cy, w, h) to corner-form (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max).

methods.name: box_xyxy_to_cxcywh(x)
methods.description: Converts bounding box coordinates from corner-form (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max) to center-form (cx, cy, w, h).

methods.name: box_iou(boxes1, boxes2)
methods.description: Calculates Intersection over Union (IoU) and union areas for pairs of bounding boxes.

methods.name: generalized_box_iou(boxes1, boxes2)
methods.description: Calculates the Generalized IoU between two sets of boxes, extending IoU to provide a more complete metric.

methods.name: masks_to_boxes(masks)
methods.description: Computes bounding boxes in xyxy format from binary masks.
